structured_output.what_is_happening: BUTTPHIL (BdBYu…) is a copycat of an existing BUTTPHIL token. Its pool was created at 08:03 UTC directly on PumpSwap, without a pump.fun curve and without a pump-suffix address. That is about 27 minutes after the apparent canonical BUTTPHIL (HBDC…pump), which the packet shows at about $207k market cap with $3.5M of volume in the past hour. This clone had about $250k of volume in 10 minutes and 2,051 unique buyers against only 57 unique sellers. Its liquidity (about $31–36k) is larger than its market cap, and 100% of the LP is unlocked. Between detection and data collection, 43 seconds later, the market cap fell from $30.3k to $21.9k (-28%). The pattern looks like a dev-seeded pool that uses many small bot buys to show up on scanners, a common setup for pulling liquidity.
